name: Ultrasonic distance sensor (HC-SR04)
description: Measures distance from 2 to 400 cm. Pulse TRIG HIGH for 10 µs; ECHO then goes HIGH for 58 µs per cm. In code: digitalWrite(trig, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(10); digitalWrite(trig, LOW); cm = pulseIn(echo, HIGH, 30000) / 58. VCC to 5V, GND to GND.

pins.label: TRIG
pins.description: Trigger input: a HIGH pulse of at least 10 µs starts one measurement.

pins.label: ECHO
pins.description: Echo output (5 V): HIGH for the sound's round-trip time, 58 µs per cm. Stays HIGH ~38 ms when nothing is in range.

props.label: Distance to target
props.description: Distance to the nearest object in front of the sensor. Over 400 cm (or 0) = nothing in range: ECHO stays HIGH for the 38 ms timeout. A world with physics overrides it every step with a raycast.

props.label: Air temperature
props.description: Sets the speed of sound (331.3 + 0.606·T m/s); 20 °C → 343.4 m/s → 58.2 µs per cm round trip.

bindings.description: A measurement is in progress (burst sent, waiting for the echo).
Distance label, e.g. "23 cm" or "> 400 cm".
Width of the last ECHO pulse in µs (0 before the first).
